PTO Policy (Test Fixture)

This is sample test-fixture content for the AI Orchestrator's Phase 2
Search pipeline. It is not real EZOFIS documentation.

Employees accrue paid time off (PTO) at a rate of 1.5 days per month of
full-time employment. Unused PTO carries over into the next calendar year
up to a maximum of 10 days. To request vacation, submit a PTO request to
your manager at least two weeks in advance through the internal portal.

Sick leave is tracked separately from vacation PTO and does not require
advance notice. Employees should notify their manager as soon as
reasonably possible when taking sick leave.
